name: Mahou Shoujo Satsuki-chan ~Mahou Oukoku Tenpuku-hen~
original_name: 魔法少女五月ちゃん～魔法王国転覆編～
source:
Three pretty babes play a role in the overthrow of the Magical Kingdom placed under the strong wizard's oppressive rule. But they are defeated and happens to be humiliated by men and tentacle monsters.
